## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Adoption rewrites configuration files even when every incoming value already matches, violating the module’s promise to preserve untouched files.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/config.py:15 — correctness — With `{"theme":"dark"}\n` already on disk, `merge(path, {"theme": "dark"}, adopt=True)` unconditionally records a change and rewrites the file with different formatting. Preserve adoption reporting while tracking actual value changes separately to decide whether to write. — Adopting already-matching settings destroys existing formatting and causes unnecessary file writes.
